title: Owner onboarding
summary: A restaurant owner signs up, creates her restaurant and lands on the setup checklist. The storefront isn't public yet.

title: Business details, brand and theme
summary: Business details, then the brand: logo, tagline, story, cuisines and order links — and the storefront updates.

title: Kitchen, ordering options and hours
summary: Kitchen address and map location, delivery/pickup switches, preparation time and the weekly opening-hours editor.

title: Delivery areas
summary: Pincode-based and distance-based delivery areas with fee, minimum order and delivery time; validation, edit, deactivate and remove.

title: Building the menu
summary: Categories, option groups (portion size, add-ons), items with photos, food type and spice; drafts vs published; duplicate, reorder and bulk publish.

title: Publishing the storefront
summary: With every setup step complete, the owner publishes; the storefront goes live for customers.

title: Appearance: styles and a custom look
summary: Twelve ready-made styles applied in one click, fine-tuning with a live preview, the readability guardrail, then publishing.

title: Offers and coupon codes
summary: Fixed and percentage coupons with minimums, caps, first-order-only and hidden codes; validation; pause and resume; the customer offers page.

title: A customer browsing the storefront
summary: Home, category chips, category and dish pages, search, options, cart drawer and sticky cart bar, delivery areas, contact and the not-found page.

title: Live changes from the admin to the storefront
summary: Price change, out of stock (with automatic return), bulk stock changes, pausing orders, and a price change in the middle of a customer's checkout.

title: Checkout edge cases
summary: Missing details, an address outside the delivery area, location-based delivery, minimum order, coupon rules, a failed payment and a retry.

title: From new order to delivered
summary: New-order alert on the board, accept → preparing → ready → dispatch with a rider; a failed delivery and reassignment; delivered — while the customer's order page updates by itself. Plus a pickup order through to collected.

title: Cancellations, refunds, notes and reordering
summary: Cancelling a paid order with a reason and refund, a partial refund, internal notes, and the customer reordering a past order.

title: Team and roles
summary: The owner invites kitchen staff; the cook signs up and sees only what the Kitchen role allows; the owner changes the role, removes and restores access.

title: Analytics, customers, messages and audit log
summary: Sales figures that reconcile with orders, the daily chart and its table view, customer history and consent, every customer message, and who changed what.

title: Unpaid orders expire (part 1)
summary: A customer places an order and leaves without paying. It waits under “Awaiting payment”, never on the kitchen board.

title: Unpaid orders expire (part 2)
summary: Six minutes later: the order was cancelled automatically, coupon usage released, and both sides show why.

title: When a message can't be delivered
summary: The messaging provider is down: sends are retried with back-off, then marked Failed and flagged; once it recovers, one click retries.

title: Taking the storefront offline and back
summary: Unpublishing shows customers “Coming soon”; publishing again restores the live store.
